title: The Starsong Chronicles

canon_policy.notes: Ellena, Aldamar, Earth-destruction events, portal cosmology, refugee-group specifics, locations, and plot remain source-bound. The title, 2018 Drive creation timestamp, 2019 document footer, and threshold/world-displacement mechanisms may be compared against later Rowan systems as provenance, but direct descent must be demonstrated rather than assumed.

mechanisms.name: catastrophe-to-threshold-to-arrival
mechanisms.description: A collapsing source world forces a cohort through an anomalous portal into a radically different environment.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Model migration or world-transition as source-state, threshold event, transit, arrival, and reorientation rather than one teleport flag.

mechanisms.name: threshold-has-somatic-cost
mechanisms.description: Transit is experienced through cold, heat, nausea, disorientation, injury, and delayed sensory recovery.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Transformation and threshold animation may expose transition cost or instability as receipts instead of presenting every state change as frictionless.

mechanisms.name: familiar-anchor-after-displacement
mechanisms.description: After extreme disorientation, a familiar person, scent, touch, or object provides immediate continuity and orientation.
mechanisms.codex_translation: After a major mode/world switch, preserve a stable identity or continuity anchor so the user knows what remained constant.

mechanisms.name: portal-lifecycle
mechanisms.description: The portal has operational states, can become dormant, is defended, and may need deliberate destruction to prevent harmful reuse.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Treat portals, bridges, connectors, and channels as stateful infrastructure with open, unstable, dormant, defended, sealed, and destroyed states.

mechanisms.name: cohort-survival-with-uncertain-total
mechanisms.description: The local survivor group is countable while the existence of other surviving groups through other portals remains unknown.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Keep local census, known external cohorts, and unknown possible branches separate; absence of contact does not prove absence of other survivors.

mechanisms.name: continuity-under-radical-environment-change
mechanisms.description: The people remain themselves while their surrounding world changes abruptly from a familiar shoreline to an alien jungle.
mechanisms.codex_translation: World-state transformation must preserve participant identity and ancestry unless an explicit transformation event changes them.

mechanisms.name: echo-signal-with-unknown-referent
mechanisms.description: Faint mental echoes are experienced while the narrator explicitly does not know who is alive, dead, present, or absent.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Render weak signals as weak signals with unknown referents; do not promote felt or partial echoes into identified participants without evidence.

mechanisms.name: continuity-statement-after-loss
mechanisms.description: The group frames survival as not-yet-lost even after catastrophic rupture, preserving identity without pretending the old world remains intact.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Support continuity that acknowledges rupture: survival may preserve lineage while world state, population, and available infrastructure have materially changed.

laws: threshold transit is an event with receipts, not an invisible cut
participant continuity survives environmental substitution unless explicitly changed
known local survivors != total survivors everywhere
weak echoes do not identify their source by themselves
portal state and portal access authority remain explicit
rupture does not require identity erasure
universal_codex_visual_ideas: portal edges that visibly move through active, unstable, dormant, sealed, and destroyed states
arrival animation that briefly carries cold/heat distortion and orientation loss before settling
a familiar continuity-thread or anchor sigil that remains visible through a world morph
cohort map with known local nodes, confirmed remote nodes, and unresolved dark regions rather than invented population fill
world-page transformation in which landscape changes completely while participant identity marks remain fixed
faint echo filaments that remain anonymous until provenance resolves them
prohibitions: Do not import The Starsong Chronicles characters, Aldamar, portal lore, apocalypse events, or plot into ArcSweep or Terra Aeterna canon automatically.
Do not treat the shared word Starsong as proof of direct continuity with later projects without chronology and explicit adoption evidence.
Do not identify weak or ambiguous signals merely because they feel familiar.
Do not fill unknown survivor branches with inferred people or histories.
Do not make a world transition erase participant identity or provenance unless the source state actually changes them.
